parameters.value: export default async function ({ page, context = {} }) {   const reply = (data) => ({     data,     type: 'application/json'   });    const pause = (ms) =>     new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));    const origin = 'https://loadia.app';   const mode = 'stats';   const selector = '.l-stats-page .l-stat-tile';    const isAuth = (cookie) =>     cookie &&     typeof cookie.name === 'string' &&     typeof cookie.value === 'string' &&     /-auth-token(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(cookie.name);    const failures = new Map();   const authResponses = [];    let injectedCount = 0;   let storedCount = null;   let stage = 'configuration';    async function diagnose() {     const authRequests = await Promise.all(       authResponses.map(async (entry) => {         let code = null;          try {           const body = await entry.response.json();            code = [             body.error_code,             body.code,             body.error           ].find(             (value) =>               typeof value === 'string' &&               /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,79}$/i.test(value)           ) || null;         } catch {}          return {           date: entry.date,           http: entry.response.status(),           grant_type: entry.grantType,           code         };       })     );      let state = {};      try {       state = await page.evaluate((target) => {         const visible = (element) => {           if (             !element ||             !element.getClientRects().length           ) {             return false;           }            const style = getComputedStyle(element);            return (             style.display !== 'none' &&             style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&             style.visibility !== 'collapse'           );         };          const anyVisible = (css) =>           [...document.querySelectorAll(css)].some(visible);          return {           page: location.origin + location.pathname,           donnees_visibles: anyVisible(target),           bouton_deconnexion_visible: anyVisible(             '.l-rail button[aria-label="Se d\u00e9connecter"]'           ),           champ_mot_de_passe_visible: anyVisible(             'input[type="password"]'           ),           route_connexion:             /\/(login|signin|sign-in|auth|connexion)(\/|$)/i               .test(location.pathname)         };       }, selector);     } catch {}      let remaining = null;      try {       remaining = (         await page.cookies(origin + '/')       ).filter(isAuth).length;     } catch {}      return {       mode,       etape: stage,       ...state,       date_diagnostic: new Date().toISOString(),       date_verification:         context.verificationDate || null,       cookies_injectes: injectedCount,       cookies_stockes_apres_injection: storedCount,       cookies_presents: remaining,       erreurs_auth_supabase: authRequests,       requetes_en_echec: [...failures]         .slice(0, 10)         .map(([url, http]) => ({ url, http }))     };   }    function readDOM() {     const text = (node) =>       (node?.textContent || '')         .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')         .trim();      const root = document.querySelector('.l-stats-page');      if (!root) {       throw new Error('STATS_MISSING');     }      function findPanel(scope, title) {       const panel = [         ...scope.querySelectorAll('.l-stats-panel')       ].find(         (node) =>           text(node.querySelector('h3')) === title       );        if (!panel) {         throw new Error('PANEL_MISSING');       }        return panel;     }      function readBreakdown(panel) {       const list = panel.querySelector(         '.l-breakdown-list'       );        if (         !list &&         !panel.querySelector('.l-field-hint')       ) {         throw new Error('BREAKDOWN_STRUCTURE');       }        return [         ...panel.querySelectorAll('.l-breakdown-list li')       ].map((row) => {         const label = text(row.querySelector('span'));         const value = text(row.querySelector('strong'));          if (!label || !value) {           throw new Error('BREAKDOWN_STRUCTURE');         }          return { label, value };       });     }      function readTiles(scope) {       if (!scope) {         throw new Error('TILES_MISSING');       }        return [         ...scope.querySelectorAll('.l-stat-tile')       ].map((tile) => ({         label: text(tile.querySelector('span')),         value: text(tile.querySelector('strong'))       }));     }      const platformPanel = findPanel(root, 'Plateformes');     const platforms = readBreakdown(platformPanel);      const advancedBody = root.querySelector(       '.l-advanced-body'     );      let advanced = null;      if (advancedBody) {       const yearsPanel = findPanel(         advancedBody,         'Ann\u00e9es'       );        advanced = {         records: readTiles(           advancedBody.querySelector(             '.l-stat-grid-records'           )         ),          years: [           ...yearsPanel.querySelectorAll(             '.l-stats-table [role="row"]'           )         ].map((row) => {           const cells = [             ...row.querySelectorAll('[role="cell"]')           ].map(text);            if (cells.length !== 3) {             throw new Error('YEARS_STRUCTURE');           }            return {             year: cells[0],             entries: cells[1],             rating: cells[2]           };         }),          genres: readBreakdown(           findPanel(             advancedBody,             'Genres les plus jou\u00e9s'           )         ),          studios: readBreakdown(           findPanel(             advancedBody,             'Studios les plus jou\u00e9s'           )         ),          releaseEras: readBreakdown(           findPanel(             advancedBody,             '\u00c9poques de sortie'           )         ),          hoursByPlatform: readBreakdown(           findPanel(             advancedBody,             'Heures par plateforme'           )         )       };     }      return {       tiles: readTiles(         root.querySelector('.l-stat-grid')       ),        ratings: [         ...root.querySelectorAll('.l-rating-bar-row')       ].map((row) => ({         label: text(row.querySelector('span')),         value: text(row.querySelector('strong'))       })),        platforms,        platformsText: platforms.length         ? platforms             .map((row) => row.label + ' : ' + row.value)             .join(' | ')         : text(             platformPanel.querySelector('.l-field-hint')           ) || null,        advanced     };   }    try {     let cookies = context.cookies;      if (typeof cookies === 'string') {       try {         cookies = JSON.parse(cookies);       } catch {         throw new Error('COOKIES');       }     }      if (!Array.isArray(cookies)) {       throw new Error('COOKIES');     }      cookies = cookies.filter(       (cookie) =>         isAuth(cookie) &&         (           !cookie.domain ||           cookie.domain.replace(/^\./, '') ===             'loadia.app'         )     );      if (!cookies.length) {       throw new Error('COOKIES');     }      injectedCount = cookies.length;      await page.setCookie(       ...cookies.map((cookie) => {         const item = {           name: cookie.name,           value: cookie.value,           url: origin + '/',           path: '/',           secure: true,           httpOnly: !!cookie.httpOnly,           sameSite: {             lax: 'Lax',             strict: 'Strict',             none: 'None',             no_restriction: 'None'           }[             String(cookie.sameSite || 'lax')               .toLowerCase()           ] || 'Lax'         };          const expiry = Number(           cookie.expires ?? cookie.expirationDate         );          if (           Number.isFinite(expiry) &&           expiry > 0         ) {           item.expires = expiry;         }          return item;       })     );      storedCount = (       await page.cookies(origin + '/')     ).filter(isAuth).length;      await page.setViewport({       width: 1440,       height: 1000     });      await page.setExtraHTTPHeaders({       'Accept-Language': 'fr-FR,fr;q=0.9'     });      page.on('response', (response) => {       const request = response.request();       const url = new URL(response.url());        if (         url.hostname.endsWith('.supabase.co') &&         url.pathname === '/auth/v1/token' &&         response.status() >= 400       ) {         const grantType = url.searchParams.get(           'grant_type'         );          authResponses.push({           response,           date: new Date().toISOString(),           grantType: [             'refresh_token',             'password',             'pkce',             'id_token'           ].includes(grantType)             ? grantType             : 'other'         });          if (authResponses.length > 10) {           authResponses.shift();         }       }        if (         ['xhr', 'fetch'].includes(           request.resourceType()         ) &&         (           url.hostname === 'loadia.app' ||           url.hostname.endsWith('.supabase.co')         )       ) {         const key = url.origin + url.pathname;          if (response.status() >= 400) {           failures.set(key, response.status());         } else {           failures.delete(key);         }       }     });      stage = 'navigation';      const response = await page.goto(       origin + '/app/stats?lang=fr',       {         waitUntil: 'networkidle2',         timeout: 40000       }     );      if (response && response.status() >= 400) {       throw new Error('HTTP_' + response.status());     }      stage = 'page readiness';      try {       const handle = await page.waitForSelector(         selector,         {           visible: true,           timeout: 30000         }       );        if (handle) {         await handle.dispose();       }     } catch (error) {       if (error.name === 'TimeoutError') {         throw new Error('PAGE_NOT_READY');       }        throw error;     }      stage = 'data stabilization';      let snapshot;     let previous = '';     let stable = 0;      for (       let attempt = 0;       attempt < 20 && stable < 3;       attempt++     ) {       snapshot = await page.evaluate(readDOM);        const signature = JSON.stringify(snapshot);        stable = signature === previous         ? stable + 1         : 0;        previous = signature;        await pause(500);     }      if (stable < 3) {       throw new Error('UNSTABLE');     }      if (snapshot.tiles.length < 15) {       throw new Error('INCOMPLETE');     }      if (failures.size) {       throw new Error('DATA_REQUEST');     }      return reply({       statut_session: 'valide',       date_extraction: new Date().toISOString(),       donnees: snapshot     });   } catch (error) {     const diagnostic = await diagnose();      if (       error.message === 'PAGE_NOT_READY' &&       !diagnostic.bouton_deconnexion_visible &&       (         diagnostic.champ_mot_de_passe_visible ||         diagnostic.route_connexion       )     ) {       return reply({         statut_session: 'invalide',         erreur:           'Loadia still displays a login screen after waiting. Refresh cookie_loadia and run the workflow from the start.',         diagnostic       });     }      const messages = {       STATS_MISSING:         'The statistics section was not found.',       PANEL_MISSING:         'A statistics panel was not found. Check the page structure.',       BREAKDOWN_STRUCTURE:         'Cannot read names and values from a statistics list.',       TILES_MISSING:         'A statistics grid was not found.',       YEARS_STRUCTURE:         'Cannot read the annual statistics table.',       COOKIES:         'Loadia cookies are missing or invalid.',       INCOMPLETE:         'Incomplete extraction: some expected data is missing.',       UNSTABLE:         'Data is still changing. Run the node again.',       DATA_REQUEST:         'A Loadia data request failed. Run the node again.',       PAGE_NOT_READY:         diagnostic.bouton_deconnexion_visible           ? 'Loadia navigation is visible, but the requested data did not load.'           : 'The requested Loadia page did not load. Check diagnostic.'     };      let message =       messages[error.message] ||       'Extraction failed during: ' + stage;      if (/ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED/.test(error.message)) {       message = 'DNS resolution failed for Loadia.';     }      if (/^HTTP_\d+$/.test(error.message)) {       message = 'Loadia returned: ' + error.message;     }      return reply({       statut_session: 'erreur',       erreur: message,       diagnostic     });   } }

parameters.value: export default async function ({ page, context = {} }) {   const reply = (data) => ({     data,     type: 'application/json'   });    const pause = (ms) =>     new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));    const origin = 'https://loadia.app';   const deadline = Date.now() + 110000;    const selectors = {     logout:       '.l-rail button[aria-label="Se déconnecter"]',     email: 'form input[type="email"]',     password: 'form input[type="password"]',     submit: 'form button[type="submit"]'   };    let stage = 'initialisation';   let cookieState = 'non_testé';   let injectedCount = 0;   let loginAttempted = false;    const checkBudget = () => {     if (Date.now() >= deadline) {       throw new Error('TIME_BUDGET');     }   };    const absoluteUrl = (path) => {     if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(path)) {       return path;     }      return `${origin}${path}`;   };    const navigate = async (path) => {     checkBudget();      await page.goto(absoluteUrl(path), {       waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',       timeout: 30000     });      await pause(1500);   };    const normalizeCookie = (cookie) => {     if (!cookie || typeof cookie !== 'object') {       return null;     }      if (!cookie.name || cookie.value === undefined) {       return null;     }      const normalized = {       name: String(cookie.name),       value: String(cookie.value)     };      if (cookie.domain) {       normalized.domain = cookie.domain;     } else {       normalized.domain = 'loadia.app';     }      if (cookie.path) {       normalized.path = cookie.path;     } else {       normalized.path = '/';     }      if (cookie.expires !== undefined) {       const expires = Number(cookie.expires);        if (Number.isFinite(expires) && expires > 0) {         normalized.expires = expires;       }     }      if (cookie.httpOnly !== undefined) {       normalized.httpOnly = Boolean(cookie.httpOnly);     }      if (cookie.secure !== undefined) {       normalized.secure = Boolean(cookie.secure);     } else {       normalized.secure = true;     }      if (cookie.sameSite) {       let sameSite = String(cookie.sameSite);        if (         sameSite.toLowerCase() === 'no_restriction' ||         sameSite.toLowerCase() === 'none'       ) {         sameSite = 'None';       } else if (sameSite.toLowerCase() === 'lax') {         sameSite = 'Lax';       } else if (sameSite.toLowerCase() === 'strict') {         sameSite = 'Strict';       } else {         sameSite = undefined;       }        if (sameSite) {         normalized.sameSite = sameSite;       }     }      return normalized;   };    const normalizeCookies = (value) => {     let source = value;      if (typeof source === 'string') {       try {         source = JSON.parse(source);       } catch (error) {         return [];       }     }      if (       source &&       typeof source === 'object' &&       !Array.isArray(source) &&       Array.isArray(source.cookies)     ) {       source = source.cookies;     }      if (!Array.isArray(source)) {       return [];     }      return source       .map(normalizeCookie)       .filter(Boolean);   };    const currentCookies = async () => {     const cookies = await page.cookies();      return cookies.map((cookie) => ({       name: cookie.name,       value: cookie.value,       domain: cookie.domain,       path: cookie.path,       expires: cookie.expires,       httpOnly: cookie.httpOnly,       secure: cookie.secure,       sameSite: cookie.sameSite     }));   };    const state = async () => {     return await page.evaluate((selectors) => {       const bodyText =         document.body?.innerText || '';        const url = window.location.href;        const logoutButton =         document.querySelector(selectors.logout);        const emailInput =         document.querySelector(selectors.email);        const passwordInput =         document.querySelector(selectors.password);        const loginForm =         Boolean(emailInput && passwordInput);        const loginRoute =         /\/sign-in/i.test(url) ||         /\/login/i.test(url);        const connected =         Boolean(logoutButton);        return {         page: url,         connected,         loginForm,         loginRoute,         bodyText: bodyText.slice(0, 3000)       };     }, selectors);   };    const waitForSession = async (timeout = 20000) => {     const end = Date.now() + timeout;      while (Date.now() < end) {       checkBudget();        const current = await state();        if (current.connected) {         return true;       }        if (         current.loginForm ||         current.loginRoute       ) {         return false;       }        await pause(750);     }      return false;   };    const success = async (method) => {     const cookies = await currentCookies();     const current = await state();      return reply({       statut_session: 'valide',       date_extraction:         new Date().toISOString(),       methode_authentification: method,       reconnexion_effectuee:         method === 'identifiants',       cookies,       diagnostic: {         etape: stage,         page: current.page || null,         bouton_deconnexion_visible:           Boolean(current.connected),         formulaire_connexion_visible:           Boolean(current.loginForm),         etat_cookie_initial: cookieState,         cookies_injectes: injectedCount,         tentative_reconnexion:           loginAttempted       }     });   };    const getSupabaseErrors = async () => {     return await page.evaluate(() => {       const texts = Array.from(         document.querySelectorAll(           '[role="alert"], .text-destructive, .text-red-500, .text-red-600'         )       )         .map((element) =>           String(             element.textContent || ''           ).trim()         )         .filter(Boolean);        return [...new Set(texts)];     });   };    const fillInput = async (     selector,     value   ) => {     const input =       await page.$(selector);      if (!input) {       throw new Error(         `INPUT_NOT_FOUND:${selector}`       );     }      await input.click({       clickCount: 3     });      await page.keyboard.press(       'Backspace'     );      await input.type(String(value), {       delay: 25     });   };    const login = async () => {     loginAttempted = true;     stage = 'connexion par identifiants';      const email =       String(context.email || '').trim();      const password =       String(context.password || '');      if (!email || !password) {       throw new Error(         'IDENTIFIANTS_MANQUANTS'       );     }      let current = await state();      if (       !current.loginForm &&       !current.loginRoute     ) {       await navigate(         '/app/sign-in?lang=fr'       );     }      const formReady =       await page         .waitForSelector(           selectors.email,           {             timeout: 15000           }         )         .catch(() => null);      if (!formReady) {       throw new Error(         'FORMULAIRE_CONNEXION_INTROUVABLE'       );     }      await fillInput(       selectors.email,       email     );      await fillInput(       selectors.password,       password     );      const submit =       await page.$(         selectors.submit       );      if (!submit) {       throw new Error(         'BOUTON_CONNEXION_INTROUVABLE'       );     }      await Promise.all([       submit.click(),       pause(1000)     ]);      const end =       Date.now() + 30000;      while (Date.now() < end) {       checkBudget();        current = await state();        if (current.connected) {         return true;       }        const cookies =         await currentCookies();        if (         cookies.length > 0 &&         !current.loginForm &&         !current.loginRoute       ) {         return true;       }        await pause(1000);     }      const errors =       await getSupabaseErrors();      throw new Error(       errors.length         ? `LOGIN_FAILED:${errors.join(' | ')}`         : 'LOGIN_FAILED'     );   };    try {     stage = 'préparation';      await page.setUserAgent(       'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'     );      await page.setViewport({       width: 1365,       height: 900     });      const cookies =       normalizeCookies(         context.cookies       );      if (cookies.length > 0) {       stage = 'injection cookie';        try {         await page.setCookie(           ...cookies         );          injectedCount =           cookies.length;          cookieState =           'cookies_injectés';       } catch (error) {         cookieState =           'erreur_injection_cookie';       }     } else {       cookieState =         'cookies_absents';     }      /*      * 1. On teste d'abord le cookie.      *      * IMPORTANT :      * si le cookie est invalide,      * expiré ou impossible à vérifier,      * on NE BLOQUE PLUS le workflow.      *      * On continue ensuite avec      * la connexion par identifiants.      */     if (injectedCount) {       stage =         'cookie verification';        try {         await navigate(           '/app/?lang=fr'         );          if (           await waitForSession(             20000           )         ) {           if (             (               await currentCookies()             ).length           ) {             return await success(               'cookie'             );           }            cookieState =             'cookies_absents';         } else {           /*            * Cookie invalide ou            * expiré :            * on passe aux            * identifiants.            */           cookieState =             'session_invalide';         }       } catch (cookieError) {         /*          * Seul le timeout global          * doit réellement arrêter          * le traitement.          */         if (           cookieError?.message ===           'TIME_BUDGET'         ) {           throw cookieError;         }          /*          * Toute autre erreur          * pendant le test cookie          * déclenche le fallback          * identifiants.          */         cookieState =           'verification_cookie_echouee';       }     }      /*      * 2. Le cookie n'a pas      * fonctionné.      *      * On utilise automatiquement :      * context.email      * context.password      */     stage =       'préparation reconnexion';      const current =       await state();      if (       !current.loginForm &&       !current.loginRoute     ) {       await navigate(         '/app/sign-in?lang=fr'       );     }      /*      * 3. Connexion avec      * mail_loadia / mdp_loadia      */     await login();      /*      * 4. Vérification de la      * nouvelle session.      */     stage =       'vérification après connexion';      await navigate(       '/app/?lang=fr'     );      const connected =       await waitForSession(         20000       );      if (!connected) {       throw new Error(         'SESSION_INVALIDE_APRES_CONNEXION'       );     }      /*      * 5. Les nouveaux cookies      * sont renvoyés au workflow.      */     return await success(       'identifiants'     );   } catch (error) {     let current = {};      try {       current =         await state();     } catch (_) {}      let errors = [];      try {       errors =         await getSupabaseErrors();     } catch (_) {}      const message =       error?.message ||       String(error);      const invalid =       [         'IDENTIFIANTS_MANQUANTS',         'LOGIN_FAILED',         'SESSION_INVALIDE_APRES_CONNEXION'       ].some((code) =>         message.includes(code)       );      return reply({       statut_session:         invalid           ? 'invalide'           : 'erreur',        erreur: message,        diagnostic: {         etape: stage,         page:           current.page || null,          bouton_deconnexion_visible:           Boolean(             current.connected           ),          formulaire_connexion_visible:           Boolean(             current.loginForm           ),          etat_cookie_initial:           cookieState,          cookies_injectes:           injectedCount,          tentative_reconnexion:           loginAttempted,          erreurs_auth_supabase:           errors       }     });   } }

parameters.value: export default async function loadiaLibrary({ page, context = {} }) {   const reply = data => ({ data, type: 'application/json' });    const pause = ms =>     new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));    const origin = 'https://loadia.app';   const selector = 'main.l-main .l-head-count';   const deadline = Date.now() + 110000;    const isAuth = cookie =>     cookie &&     typeof cookie.name === 'string' &&     typeof cookie.value === 'string' &&     /-auth-token(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(cookie.name);    const failures = new Map();   const authResponses = [];   const games = new Map();    let injectedCount = 0;   let storedCount = null;   let expected = null;   let clicks = 0;   let stage = 'configuration';    function timeout(maximum) {     const remaining = deadline - Date.now();      if (remaining < 1000) {       throw new Error('DEADLINE');     }      return Math.min(maximum, remaining);   }    function moreButton() {     return [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => {       const label = (button.textContent || '')         .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')         .trim();        const style = getComputedStyle(button);        return (         /^Afficher plus de jeux$/i.test(label) &&         button.getClientRects().length > 0 &&         style.display !== 'none' &&         style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&         style.visibility !== 'collapse' &&         !button.disabled &&         button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true' &&         button.getAttribute('aria-busy') !== 'true'       );     }) || false;   }    function newCards(knownIds) {     const known = new Set(knownIds);      return [...document.querySelectorAll(       'main.l-main .l-grid a.l-tile[href]'     )].some(card => {       const url = new URL(         card.getAttribute('href'),         location.origin       );        const id = url.pathname         .replace(/\/$/, '')         .split('/')         .pop();        return id && !known.has(id);     });   }    function readLibrary() {     const text = element =>       (element?.textContent || '')         .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')         .trim();      const normalize = value =>       String(value || '')         .normalize('NFD')         .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')         .replace(/\u0153/g, 'oe')         .toLowerCase();      const root = document.querySelector('main.l-main');      if (!root) {       throw new Error('LIBRARY_NOT_FOUND');     }      const counts = Object.fromEntries(       [...root.querySelectorAll(         '.l-toolbar[aria-label="Collection"] button'       )]         .filter(button => button.querySelector('.l-count'))         .map(button => {           const count = text(button.querySelector('.l-count'));           const copy = button.cloneNode(true);            copy.querySelector('.l-count').remove();            return [text(copy), count];         })     );      const entries = [...root.querySelectorAll(       '.l-grid a.l-tile[href]'     )].map(card => {       const url = new URL(         card.getAttribute('href'),         location.origin       );        const badge = card.querySelector(         '.is-status[data-status]'       );        const rating = card.querySelector('.l-cover-rating');        const marks = [...card.querySelectorAll('.l-cover-mark')]         .map(mark =>           mark.getAttribute('title') ||           mark.getAttribute('aria-label') ||           text(mark)         )         .filter(Boolean);        return {         id: url.pathname           .replace(/\/$/, '')           .split('/')           .pop(),          titre:           card.getAttribute('title') ||           card.getAttribute('aria-label'),          url: url.origin + url.pathname,          image:           card.querySelector('img')?.getAttribute('src') ||           null,          statut:           badge?.getAttribute('data-status') ||           null,          libelle_statut:           badge?.getAttribute('title') ||           badge?.getAttribute('aria-label') ||           null,          note_texte: rating           ? (             rating.getAttribute('title') ||             rating.getAttribute('aria-label') ||             text(rating)           )           : null,          coup_de_coeur:           Boolean(card.querySelector('.l-cover-mark.is-loved')) ||           marks.some(mark =>             /coups? de coeur/.test(normalize(mark))           ),          complete_100_pourcent:           marks.some(mark => /100\s*%/.test(mark)),          marques: marks       };     });      return {       reportedTotal: text(root.querySelector('.l-head-count')),       counts,       games: entries     };   }    async function stableLibrary() {     const end = Date.now() + timeout(10000);      let previous = '';     let stable = 0;     let snapshot;      while (Date.now() < end) {       snapshot = await page.evaluate(readLibrary);        const signature = JSON.stringify(snapshot);        stable = signature === previous ? stable + 1 : 0;        if (stable >= 3) {         return snapshot;       }        previous = signature;        await pause(500);     }      throw new Error('UNSTABLE');   }    function totalOf(snapshot) {     const value = String(snapshot.counts.Tout ?? '')       .replace(/\s/g, '');      if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) {       throw new Error('TOTAL');     }      const total = Number(value);      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total)) {       throw new Error('TOTAL');     }      return total;   }    function collect(snapshot) {     if (totalOf(snapshot) !== expected) {       throw new Error('TOTAL_CHANGED');     }      for (const game of snapshot.games) {       if (!game.id || !game.titre) {         throw new Error('INVALID_GAME');       }        games.set(game.id, game);     }      if (games.size > expected) {       throw new Error('INCOMPLETE');     }   }    async function diagnose() {     const authRequests = await Promise.all(       authResponses.map(async entry => {         let code = null;          try {           const body = await entry.response.json();            code = [             body.error_code,             body.code,             body.error           ].find(value =>             typeof value === 'string' &&             /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,79}$/i.test(value)           ) || null;         } catch {}          return {           date: entry.date,           http: entry.response.status(),           grant_type: entry.grantType,           code         };       })     );      let state = {};      try {       state = await page.evaluate(target => {         const visible = element => {           if (!element || !element.getClientRects().length) {             return false;           }            const style = getComputedStyle(element);            return (             style.display !== 'none' &&             style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&             style.visibility !== 'collapse'           );         };          const anyVisible = css =>           [...document.querySelectorAll(css)].some(visible);          return {           page: location.origin + location.pathname,            donnees_visibles: anyVisible(target),            bouton_deconnexion_visible: anyVisible(             '.l-rail button[aria-label="Se d\u00e9connecter"]'           ),            champ_mot_de_passe_visible: anyVisible(             'input[type="password"]'           ),            route_connexion:             /\/(login|signin|sign-in|auth|connexion)(\/|$)/i               .test(location.pathname)         };       }, selector);     } catch {}      let remaining = null;      try {       remaining = (         await page.cookies(origin + '/')       ).filter(isAuth).length;     } catch {}      return {       mode: 'ludotheque',       etape: stage,       ...state,        date_diagnostic: new Date().toISOString(),       date_verification: context.verificationDate || null,        cookies_injectes: injectedCount,       cookies_stockes_apres_injection: storedCount,       cookies_presents: remaining,        jeux_attendus: expected,       jeux_collectes: games.size,       clics_afficher_plus: clicks,        erreurs_auth_supabase: authRequests,        requetes_en_echec: [...failures]         .slice(0, 10)         .map(([url, http]) => ({ url, http }))     };   }    try {     let cookies = context.cookies;      if (typeof cookies === 'string') {       try {         cookies = JSON.parse(cookies);       } catch {         throw new Error('COOKIES');       }     }      if (!Array.isArray(cookies)) {       throw new Error('COOKIES');     }      cookies = cookies.filter(cookie =>       isAuth(cookie) &&       (         !cookie.domain ||         cookie.domain.replace(/^\./, '') === 'loadia.app'       )     );      if (!cookies.length) {       throw new Error('COOKIES');     }      injectedCount = cookies.length;      await page.setCookie(...cookies.map(cookie => {       const item = {         name: cookie.name,         value: cookie.value,         url: origin + '/',         path: '/',         secure: true,         httpOnly: Boolean(cookie.httpOnly),          sameSite: {           lax: 'Lax',           strict: 'Strict',           none: 'None',           no_restriction: 'None'         }[           String(cookie.sameSite || 'lax').toLowerCase()         ] || 'Lax'       };        const expiry = Number(         cookie.expires ?? cookie.expirationDate       );        if (Number.isFinite(expiry) && expiry > 0) {         item.expires = expiry;       }        return item;     }));      storedCount = (       await page.cookies(origin + '/')     ).filter(isAuth).length;      await page.setViewport({       width: 1440,       height: 1000     });      await page.setExtraHTTPHeaders({       'Accept-Language': 'fr-FR,fr;q=0.9'     });      page.on('response', response => {       const request = response.request();       const url = new URL(response.url());        if (         url.hostname.endsWith('.supabase.co') &&         url.pathname === '/auth/v1/token' &&         response.status() >= 400       ) {         const grantType = url.searchParams.get('grant_type');          authResponses.push({           response,           date: new Date().toISOString(),            grantType: [             'refresh_token',             'password',             'pkce',             'id_token'           ].includes(grantType)             ? grantType             : 'other'         });          if (authResponses.length > 10) {           authResponses.shift();         }       }        if (         ['xhr', 'fetch'].includes(request.resourceType()) &&         (           url.hostname === 'loadia.app' ||           url.hostname.endsWith('.supabase.co')         )       ) {         const key = url.origin + url.pathname;          if (response.status() >= 400) {           failures.set(key, response.status());         } else {           failures.delete(key);         }       }     });      stage = 'navigation';      const response = await page.goto(       origin + '/app/library?lang=fr',       {         waitUntil: 'networkidle2',         timeout: timeout(40000)       }     );      if (response && response.status() >= 400) {       throw new Error('HTTP_' + response.status());     }      stage = 'page readiness';      try {       const handle = await page.waitForSelector(selector, {         visible: true,         timeout: timeout(30000)       });        if (handle) {         await handle.dispose();       }     } catch (error) {       if (error.name === 'TimeoutError') {         throw new Error('PAGE_NOT_READY');       }        throw error;     }      stage = 'data stabilization';      let snapshot = await stableLibrary();      expected = totalOf(snapshot);      collect(snapshot);      while (games.size < expected) {       stage = 'load more button';        let handle;        try {         handle = await page.waitForFunction(           moreButton,           {             polling: 250,             timeout: timeout(10000)           }         );       } catch (error) {         if (error.name === 'TimeoutError') {           throw new Error('MORE_BUTTON');         }          throw error;       }        const knownIds = [...games.keys()];       const before = games.size;        try {         const button = handle.asElement();          if (!button) {           throw new Error('MORE_BUTTON');         }          await button.click();          clicks++;       } finally {         await handle.dispose();       }        stage = 'new games loading';        try {         const progress = await page.waitForFunction(           newCards,           {             polling: 250,             timeout: timeout(20000)           },           knownIds         );          await progress.dispose();       } catch (error) {         if (error.name === 'TimeoutError') {           throw new Error('NO_NEW_GAMES');         }          throw error;       }        stage = 'new games stabilization';        snapshot = await stableLibrary();        collect(snapshot);        if (games.size <= before) {         throw new Error('NO_NEW_GAMES');       }     }      stage = 'complete library';      if (games.size !== expected) {       throw new Error('INCOMPLETE');     }      if (failures.size) {       throw new Error('DATA_REQUEST');     }      snapshot.games = [...games.values()];      return reply({       statut_session: 'valide',       date_extraction: new Date().toISOString(),       donnees: snapshot     });    } catch (error) {     const diagnostic = await diagnose();      if (       error.message === 'PAGE_NOT_READY' &&       !diagnostic.bouton_deconnexion_visible &&       (         diagnostic.champ_mot_de_passe_visible ||         diagnostic.route_connexion       )     ) {       return reply({         statut_session: 'invalide',         erreur:           'Loadia still displays a login screen. Run the workflow from the start to obtain a new session.',         diagnostic       });     }      const messages = {       COOKIES:         'Missing or invalid context.cookies. Check the reference to the verification node.',        LIBRARY_NOT_FOUND:         'The Loadia library section was not found.',        TOTAL:         'The Tout counter was not found or is invalid.',        TOTAL_CHANGED:         'The Tout counter changed during extraction. Run the workflow again.',        INVALID_GAME:         'A game card has no identifier or title.',        INCOMPLETE:         'The number of collected games does not match the Tout counter.',        UNSTABLE:         'The library is still changing. Run the workflow again.',        DATA_REQUEST:         'A Loadia data request failed. Check diagnostic.',        MORE_BUTTON:         'The library is incomplete and the load more button was not available.',        NO_NEW_GAMES:         'The load more button was clicked, but no new games were collected.',        DEADLINE:         'The extraction time limit was reached before completion.',        PAGE_NOT_READY:         'The Loadia library page did not load. Check diagnostic.'     };      let message =       messages[error.message] ||       'Extraction failed during: ' + stage;      if (/ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED/.test(String(error.message))) {       message = 'DNS resolution failed for Loadia.';     }      if (/^HTTP_\d+$/.test(error.message)) {       message = 'Loadia returned: ' + error.message;     }      return reply({       statut_session: 'erreur',       erreur: message,       diagnostic     });   } }
